title: Managed held restore and release v2
description: Additive v2 superset of tianshu:restore:v1 for Restore C held release and service resumption. Preserves all v1 canonical bytes, domain-separated tianshu.restore.v1 digests, and write-once immutable .restore-origin.json (OriginV1). Adds release_intent (ReleaseIntentV1) and released (ReleasedV1) registry phases, deterministic ReconcilePlanV1, RestoreReviewV2.review_sha256, RestoreReleaseResultV2, and Post-Release Database Admission status (v2 admitted via (S, D)-bound ReleasedV1 proof without .migration.json; v1 still requires explicit tianshu data migrate before normal EventLog open).
